checkpoint_rule: Take the final iteration at every prospectively fixed root. Compare with the existing one-contact, own-view core checkpoint of the same root.
train_relation: A single two-odor private relation fixed within each example, evenly averaged across post-write probes. Random orientation at every contact, fresh relation per example, no noise or rule changes.
selection: No learning rate, feature, window, root or training length selection on validation data. Keep all results. Evaluation uses unmodified full-amplitude deployment.
